title: Best Dehumidifier for Mildew Smell (2026): Fix Musty Odors
h1: The Best Dehumidifiers for Mildew and Musty Smells
dek: That damp-basement odor isn't really a smell problem. It's a moisture problem — and the right dehumidifier removes the cause instead of covering it up.
description: The best dehumidifier for mildew smell and musty odors, from 50-pint room units to pump models and cordless closet absorbers, plus how long the fix takes.
intro: If you're shopping for a **dehumidifier for mildew smell**, here's the key fact: that musty odor comes from microbial volatile organic compounds (MVOCs), gases mold and mildew give off as they grow. The EPA notes that growth can be well underway on hidden surfaces — inside a wall cavity, under carpet padding, behind a dresser — long before you see anything.

Air fresheners and odor sprays only mask the result. An air purifier's carbon filter can soak up some of it for a while. What actually stops the smell is drying the air enough that mold and mildew can't keep growing, which means holding the room at **30–50% relative humidity** and keeping it there.

We picked dehumidifiers for every size of musty problem, from a whole basement to a single closet, with an eye on the feature that matters most for odor: running long enough, without interruption, to let damp materials dry out.
topPicksLead: For most musty rooms, the **Midea Cube 50** is the one to buy: 50 pints a day and an oversized tank that keeps it drying instead of shutting off half-full.

products.performance: It's a 50-pint-class compressor unit, enough for a closed-up guest room, a living area after a humid stretch or a modest basement. Independent measurements put its draw at roughly 500 watts, competitive for a full-size unit you'll run for days while the smell clears. Pair it with a hose to a floor drain for truly uninterrupted running.

blocks.text: That last number is the one people underestimate. Carpet, drywall, upholstery and stored boxes absorb moisture over months and release it slowly. The air dries in hours; the materials take longer.

sections.heading: How we pick dehumidifiers for musty smells

blocks.text: We don't run a smell lab. We compare capacity ratings under the 2019 DOE test, tank sizes and drainage options from manufacturer specs, humidistat type, efficiency data from ENERGY STAR, and recall history from the CPSC.

For odor specifically, we prioritized uninterrupted operation — big tanks, pumps and gravity drains — because a unit that sits full for half the day lets humidity bounce back. Then we read owner reviews for how quickly musty rooms improved and for units that developed odors of their own.

sections.heading: What to look for in a dehumidifier for mold smell

items.label: Uninterrupted drainage
items.text: A pump, gravity hose or oversized tank keeps the unit running while you're away or asleep.

items.label: A real humidistat
items.text: Set it to 45% and let the unit cycle. Our [humidistat settings guide](/guides/dehumidifier-humidistat-settings-guide/) has seasonal targets.

items.label: A separate hygrometer
items.text: Built-in sensors drift. An inexpensive standalone hygrometer confirms the room is truly below 50%.

items.label: Size for the space
items.text: A room smell needs a room unit. A smell in several rooms usually traces to a basement or crawl space feeding damp air upstairs — consider a [whole-house dehumidifier](/best/best-whole-house-dehumidifier/).

items.label: Low-temperature operation for basements
items.text: Below about 65°F, coils can frost. Auto-defrost keeps a basement unit working into the cooler months.

sections.heading: Will a dehumidifier get rid of a musty smell in a basement?

blocks.text: Usually, yes — as long as the moisture is coming from the air and not from an active leak. Here's the order that works:

items: **Measure first.** A hygrometer reading above 55–60% in the musty space confirms humidity is the culprit. If it's already in range, look for another source: an old spill, pet odor or a hidden leak.
**Fix water entry.** Clear gutters, extend downspouts and seal obvious cracks. A dehumidifier can't keep up with liquid water coming through a wall.
**Run the dehumidifier continuously at 45%** with a hose or pump so it never stalls with a full tank.
**Move air.** Pull furniture a few inches off walls, open closet doors and run a fan to help hidden surfaces dry.
**Clean and toss.** Wash fabrics, clean hard surfaces and discard porous items that stay musty after drying, such as cardboard boxes.
**Give it time.** Expect one to two weeks of steady humidity before the smell is gone.

blocks.title: When it's more than a smell
blocks.text: If you can see growth covering more than about 10 square feet, the EPA suggests professional cleanup. Our [guide to whether a dehumidifier helps with mold](/guides/does-a-dehumidifier-help-with-mold/) explains what a dehumidifier can and can't do.

sections.heading: Why does my dehumidifier smell like mildew?

blocks.text: Sometimes the musty smell is coming from the dehumidifier itself. Standing water in the bucket, a clogged air filter and dust on the coils all give mildew a place to grow inside the machine. The fix is simple:

items: Empty the bucket and wash it with warm, soapy water (or a diluted vinegar rinse), then let it dry fully.
Slide out the washable filter, rinse or vacuum it, and dry it before reinstalling.
Run the unit with the bucket emptied daily for a week; if the smell persists, gently vacuum the coil fins with a brush attachment.
In storage, keep the unit completely dry with the bucket out.

blocks.text: Our [dehumidifier maintenance guide](/guides/dehumidifier-maintenance/) covers a full cleaning routine.

The **Midea Cube 50** is the best dehumidifier for a musty or mildew smell in most rooms, because its big tank keeps it drying long enough for the odor to fade. If the smell keeps returning, the **AlorAir Sentinel HDi65** drains itself nonstop; the **hOmeLabs HME1003** lets you confirm progress with real numbers; the **Pro Breeze 30-Pint** handles a single room for less; and the **Eva-Dry E-333** is the answer for closets, cabinets and cars. Whatever you choose, hold the space below 50% and give it a couple of weeks.

faqs.q: What is the best dehumidifier for mildew smell?
faqs.a: For most rooms, the Midea Cube 50 (MAD50S1QWT). It's a 50-pint-class unit with an oversized tank, so it keeps running instead of shutting off before the odor clears. For a smell that keeps coming back, the pump-equipped AlorAir Sentinel HDi65 runs continuously; for closets and cars, the cordless Eva-Dry E-333 is the better fit.

faqs.q: Does a dehumidifier help with musty smell?
faqs.a: Yes — it treats the cause. Once humidity holds in the 30–50% range, the mold and mildew producing odor-causing MVOCs stop growing, and the smell fades over days to weeks as damp materials dry out. Unlike a spray, it doesn't come back as long as humidity stays controlled.

faqs.q: Why does my house smell musty when I can't see mold?
faqs.a: Mold and mildew release odor compounds as they grow, and that growth often starts on hidden surfaces — inside walls, under carpet, behind furniture. A musty smell is a sign of elevated humidity and active growth somewhere nearby, even without visible spots.

faqs.q: How long does it take a dehumidifier to remove a musty smell?
faqs.a: Most rooms clear within one to two weeks of steady humidity between 30% and 50%. Rooms with heavier growth in carpet, drywall or furniture can take longer, since the smell fades as those materials dry. A hygrometer confirms the humidity is actually holding.

faqs.q: Why does my dehumidifier smell musty?
faqs.a: Usually because of standing water in the bucket, a dirty filter or dust on the coils. Empty and wash the bucket, clean the filter, let everything dry and empty the bucket daily. If the odor persists, gently clean the coil fins.

faqs.q: Should I use an air purifier or a dehumidifier for musty smell?
faqs.a: A dehumidifier. An air purifier's carbon filter can reduce odor in the air temporarily, but it does nothing about the humidity that keeps mold producing it. Our [dehumidifier vs. air purifier guide](/guides/dehumidifier-vs-air-purifier/) explains which appliance fixes which problem.

faqs.q: What humidity level stops musty odor?
faqs.a: Keep the space between 30% and 50% relative humidity, per EPA guidance, and avoid letting it sit above 60% for long periods. Around 45% is a practical target for most basements and bedrooms.
